tools.name: session_brief
tools.description: Call first each session. Send the provider, model and package ids you use (never a manifest) and the cursor from your last brief. Returns status clear|changed|attention, at most 3 ordered actions (each with source, confidence and falsifier) and a new cursor to store.

tools.name: rescue
tools.description: At a failure: error text, HTTP status, or a retired model or package id. Returns an immediate fix and a fallback route (under 2 KB).

tools.name: decide
tools.description: One decision. task (words) returns a compact answer per job: pick, runner-up, sourced price, autoActOk, next call. jtbd (id) returns the decision card with its skip rule. full=true for the long form.

tools.name: depot
tools.description: Everything else, one op per call with args: estimate(jtbd, workload), quote(jtbd), search(q), stack(task), bundle(jtbds), kit(class), compare(providers), free(jtbd), check(providers), audit_repo(packages, models), stack_delta(providers, since), changes(since), answer(task), failures, coverage, fresh

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "session_brief" stacks urgency/override words (never, attention). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
